summary: FAIL_NOT_READY: PR-173 has a defensible roadmap_rescue_v1:C1 statistical-mechanics result, but the current two-value result vocabulary is not total and can misroute absent inputs or missing replicate lineage as Monte Carlo uncertainty. RESOLVED_WITHIN_REGISTERED_MC_CONTRACT also lacks an explicit preregistered decision boundary and uncertainty-method applicability gate. After adding orthogonal input-availability, lineage-certifiability, and numerical-resolution states, the card may certify finite-support and MC-error reporting mechanics without changing any upstream scientific interpretation.

claim_results.strongest_safe_result_text: Against the two hash-pinned upstream artifacts, PR-173 may certify only the finite-ensemble reporting mechanics: the PR-150 observation-inclusive empirical rank is 39/1000 with declared resolution 1/1000 and explicit noise-reuse sensitivity, while the PR-152 observation-inclusive cross-fit rank is 146/401 with declared resolution 1/401, conditional on released-data/simulation exchangeability and outside the release-validated spectrum range. This C1 result certifies rank-support and MC-uncertainty disclosure mechanics only; it does not validate either estimator, null family, covariance, transfer, or physical interpretation.
claim_results.safe_typed_result_rule: Assign RESOLVED_WITHIN_REGISTERED_MC_CONTRACT only after authenticated complete input, certified replicate lineage, a preregistered estimand and decision boundary, an applicable uncertainty method, and a non-overlap decision all pass. Assign NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_AT_CURRENT_MC_BUDGET only when those evidence gates pass but the registered uncertainty/resolution rule is inconclusive.

forbidden_drift_detected: Calling an MC-SE or finite-rank gate physical validation, estimator validation, or data validation
Calling NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_AT_CURRENT_MC_BUDGET estimator noise, physical noise, absence of signal, or evidence of a signal
Reporting p=0, Gaussian sigma, or any tail probability below 1/(N+1) from the finite ensemble
Treating support resolution 1/(N+1) as an MC standard error or treating an MC standard error as the support floor
Using RESOLVED_WITHIN_REGISTERED_MC_CONTRACT without a frozen estimand, comparison boundary, interval method, confidence level, and non-overlap rule
Counting duplicated, reused, clustered, bootstrapped, or cross-fit rows as independent units without declared lineage and dependence handling
Calling the PR-150 rank an iid exact-rank theorem despite 300 noise realizations being reused across 999 CMB realizations
Calling the PR-152 L=2..10 artifact release-validated, in-band, raw-QE reproduced, or a detection; its declared release validation range is L=40..763
Using partial or unavailable PR-151 DESI mocks for a final rank or significance, treating their absence as p=0, or extrapolating a DESI result
Pooling PR3/FFP10, ACT release simulations, DESI mocks, CF4 injections, or other heterogeneous ensembles into one effective N or one common uncertainty label

Treating C1 reporting mechanics as matched-null adequacy, covariance adequacy, independence, transfer validation, native-solver evidence, preferred-axis evidence, geometry, or Bianchi-family identification
Publishing the internal card or promoting it above roadmap_rescue_v1:C1

routing_precedence: If the input is unavailable, incomplete, or policy-forbidden, emit a NOT_EVALUATED input status, null numerical status, null rank/SE/interval, and an exact dependency/provenance pointer.

If replicate IDs, uniqueness, ordering, reuse/clustering, or manifest hashes are missing or inconsistent, emit NOT_CERTIFIABLE_MISSING_REPLICATE_LINEAGE or NOT_CERTIFIABLE_LINEAGE_CONFLICT, null numerical status, and no inferred N, SE, or rank.
Only after complete authenticated input and certified lineage may the certifier choose one of the two numerical-resolution statuses.

NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_AT_CURRENT_MC_BUDGET is valid only for a genuine finite-budget overlap under a preregistered numerical rule; it must not absorb input absence, provenance failure, invalid nulls, invalid covariance, or physical ambiguity.
terminal_routing.desi_route: PR-151 partial mocks are forbidden for final ranks/significance. Until its exact authenticated terminal receipt exists, a DESI entry must be NOT_EVALUATED_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE or NOT_EVALUATED_PARTIAL_INPUT_FORBIDDEN with all numerical result fields null. The absence is not a zero p-value and not NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED_AT_CURRENT_MC_BUDGET.
terminal_routing.schema_kill_switch: If the PR-173 schema permits only the two numerical statuses and cannot encode input/provenance blockers orthogonally, block result generation rather than overload either label.

findings.title: The two-value output vocabulary is not total over input and provenance failure
evidence: docs/codex_handoff/pr_backlog.yaml:4669-4675 restricts typed numerical outputs to resolved or numerically unresolved.
docs/PR_DELTAS/pr-167.md:75-88 forbids partial PR-151 mocks as calibrated scientific inputs.
.agent-harness/generated/CONTEXT_PACK.md#Data and resource state records PR-151 as non-terminal and forbids partial mocks for final ranks/significance.
findings.risk: Absent DESI input or missing lineage can be falsely represented as a finite-budget numerical result, obscuring a provenance blocker and enabling downstream use.
findings.required_remediation: Add orthogonal input_availability_status and replicate_lineage_status axes with null numerical output on failure. Preserve the two existing labels only for authenticated, lineage-certified numerical cases.

findings.title: RESOLVED lacks a preregistered comparison boundary and method-applicability gate
evidence: docs/codex_handoff/pr_backlog.yaml:4674-4675 requires an overlap decision but does not identify the estimand, boundary, interval method, or confidence level.

docs/generated/pr150_e2e_pooled_rank.json:54-103 explicitly rejects iid/exchangeability and reports noise-reuse sensitivities; its cluster-bootstrap 95% interval is [0.026262626262626262, 0.05321285140562249].
docs/generated/pr152_crossfit_mean_field.json:57-64 makes exactness conditional on exchangeability and reports an out-of-validation-range analysis.
findings.risk: A producer can call a value resolved merely because it is on or above the discrete support floor, or can apply an iid SE to reused/clustered units.
findings.required_remediation: Freeze per-estimand boundary, direction, tie policy, uncertainty method, confidence level, dependence applicability, and non-overlap rule before reading the result. Keep support resolution and MC sampling uncertainty as distinct fields.

findings.title: A concrete C1 finite-support mechanics result is available
evidence: PR-150: 0.039 = 39/1000 and resolution_floor = 1/1000, conditional on the hash-pinned PR3/FFP10 artifact and its declared reuse sensitivity.
PR-152: 0.3640897755610973 = 146/401 and support_resolution = 1/401, conditional on released-data/simulation exchangeability; inside_release_validated_range is false.
findings.safe_interpretation: These exact finite-support identities are useful C1 reporting mechanics. They do not settle a scientific threshold, validate a null/covariance/estimator, or alter either upstream caveat set.

findings.title: Replicate lineage must be a promotion gate, not optional metadata
evidence: docs/generated/pr150_e2e_pooled_rank.json distinguishes 999 CMB realizations from 300 reused noise realizations and explicitly disclaims iid exactness.
docs/generated/pr152_crossfit_mean_field.json declares 400 simulations, 401 exchangeable units, a permutation-equivariant transform, and an ordered input-manifest hash.
findings.risk: File counts, bootstrap draws, reused noise rows, or cross-fit views can be mistaken for independent null units, producing a false floor and false MC SE.
findings.required_remediation: Cross-bind stable replicate IDs, uniqueness, ordering, exclusions, reuse/clusters, row-to-source mapping, and manifest hash. Missing or conflicting lineage terminates as not certifiable with null N/rank/SE fields.

findings.title: The card ceiling is safe, but consumers need an explicit forbidden-promotion scanner
evidence: docs/codex_handoff/pr_backlog.yaml:4680-4690 sets C1, public_use=false, prohibits physical-validation language, and forbids subresolution extrapolation.
docs/PR_DELTAS/pr-167.md:94-108 fixes unresolved-not-estimator-noise language and blocks family/transfer promotion.
docs/generated/pr150_e2e_pooled_rank.json:108 contains the ambiguous inherited phrase HARD-validated, which PR-173 must not echo without qualification.
findings.required_remediation: Add live scanner/mutation cases for detection, significance, validated estimator/data/null/covariance, estimator noise, iid exact rank under reuse, ACT raw-QE/release-validated, DESI partial result, native transfer, preferred axis, geometry, and Bianchi family language.

proposed_changes: Specify the three-axis terminal status lattice and precedence before implementation.
Bind RESOLVED to a preregistered per-estimand decision boundary and dependence-appropriate uncertainty rule.
Make replicate-lineage validation a hard gate and preserve raw, unique, clustered, and resampled counts separately.
Define the PR-150 and PR-152 examples above as golden C1 fixtures while retaining every upstream caveat and source hash.
Add per-entry provenance because one aggregate transfer_source cannot safely represent heterogeneous source artifacts.
Replace inherited unqualified validation wording in PR-173 consumers with mechanical finite-support language.
Require a content-addressed result card, manifest, mutation report, claim-language scan, and PR delta; do not edit upstream results merely to make them fit the certifier.
tests_to_run: Golden exact-rank tests: PR-150 39/1000 and PR-152 146/401, including exact 1/(N+1) floors.
Reject p=0, a tail below the support floor, a non-integer support value, wrong denominator, and numerator/exceedance drift.
Exercise upper/lower/two-sided tails, ties, observation-inclusive scoring, max-statistic dependence, and independent calibration/evaluation splits.
Reject RESOLVED when the decision boundary, direction, confidence level, interval method, or preregistration hash is absent.
Force NUMERICALLY_UNRESOLVED when a valid interval overlaps the frozen boundary or the requested tail lies below finite resolution.
Reject iid/binomial-only uncertainty when reuse or clustering is declared; require the registered dependence-aware method.
Mutate replicate IDs by deletion, duplication, reordering, substitution, cluster reassignment, and source-manifest hash drift; every case must terminate not certifiable.
Verify bootstrap/resampling draws cannot increase the registered count of independent null units.
Feed absent and partial DESI receipts and require NOT_EVALUATED with null rank/SE/interval; verify no partial mock enters a result.
Reject cross-dataset pooling and transfer/source-provenance erasure.
Require owner, scope, C1 tier, status, source hashes, support/mask/null/covariance fields, caveats, command, runtime, and Git/worktree fields.
Run forbidden-language mutations through both resolved and unresolved routes, including the inherited HARD-validated phrase.
Run the PR card's targeted test, strict DAG/status gate, relevant smoke subset, write/check replay, and result/manifest hash validator.
risks_and_kill_switches: Kill RESOLVED if any provenance, lineage, dependence, boundary, or uncertainty-method field is missing or inconsistent.
Kill any DESI numerical entry until PR-151 is terminal-ready and the exact authenticated input receipt exists; never use partial mocks.
Kill subresolution extrapolation, p=0, and Gaussian-sigma conversion below finite rank support.
Kill scientific promotion if the MC interval/floor is used as evidence for physical signal/noise, validation, independence, covariance/null adequacy, transfer, geometry, or family.
Kill pooled effective-N reporting across heterogeneous ensembles or within reused/clustered lineages.
Kill public use and any claim tier above C1.

assumptions: The assignment's hash-pinned PR-150 and PR-152 JSON artifacts are evidence examples, not authorization to modify or reinterpret their upstream scientific claims.
No decision threshold such as 0.05 is assumed unless a future PR-173 spec preregisters it per estimand.
A finite-rank support floor and an MC sampling uncertainty are distinct quantities.
No web research was required because this assignment is a repository-local claim-vocabulary and provenance audit over hash-pinned inputs.
